from typing import List, Dict, Any, Optional
from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class LineItem(BaseModel):
    description: Optional[str] = None
    quantity: Optional[float] = None
    amount: Optional[float] = None

class ExtractedDocument(BaseModel):
    vendor_name: Optional[str] = None
    date: Optional[str] = None
    total: Optional[float] = None
    line_items: List[LineItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    merchant_name: Optional[str] = None
    tax: Optional[float] = None
    items: List[LineItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    # Add a confidence score to each field if available from the extraction service
    confidence: Dict[str, float] = Field(default_factory=dict)

class NormalizedExpense(BaseModel):
    transaction_date: Optional[str] = None
    vendor: Optional[str] = None
    total_amount: Optional[float] = None
    currency: Optional[str] = "USD"
    category: Optional[str] = "Uncategorized"
    description: Optional[str] = None
    line_items: List[LineItem] = Field(default_factory=list)
    original_document_type: Optional[str] = None # e.g., "invoice", "receipt"

from document_models import ExtractedDocument, NormalizedExpense, LineItem

def normalize_expense(extracted_document: ExtractedDocument, document_type: str) -> NormalizedExpense:
    normalized_line_items = []
    source_line_items = extracted_document.line_items if document_type == "invoice" else extracted_document.items
    
    for item in source_line_items:
        normalized_line_items.append(LineItem(
            description=item.description,
            quantity=item.quantity,
            amount=item.amount
        ))

    vendor_name = extracted_document.vendor_name if extracted_document.vendor_name else extracted_document.merchant_name
    total_amount = extracted_document.total
    transaction_date = extracted_document.date

    return NormalizedExpense(
        transaction_date=transaction_date,
        vendor=vendor_name,
        total_amount=total_amount,
        line_items=normalized_line_items,
        original_document_type=document_type
    )

import os
from google.cloud import aiplatform

def summarize_invoice(extracted_invoice_fields: dict) -> str:
    project_id = os.environ.get("GCP_PROJECT_ID")
    location = os.environ.get("GCP_LOCATION", "us-central1")

    if not project_id:
        raise ValueError("GCP_PROJECT_ID environment variable must be set.")

    aiplatform.init(project=project_id, location=location)

    # Using the TextGenerationModel from Vertex AI SDK
    # Model ID: gemini-pro (or other suitable models like text-bison)
    # Ensure the model is available in the specified location
    model = aiplatform.preview.generative_models.GenerativeModel("gemini-pro")

    prompt = f"Summarize the following invoice details in a concise manner, highlighting vendor, total, and key line items:\n\n{extracted_invoice_fields}"

    response = model.generate_content(prompt)
    return response.candidates[0].content.parts[0].text
